description: Machine-readable licence rollup for the committed corpus and data files. One entry per corpus family; `notice` names the human-readable attribution file. Guarded by test/estate/corpus-licences.test.mjs.

entries.note: CC-BY-SA-4.0, not CC-BY-4.0: the rescue rows quote and word-substitute Wikipedia sentences from corpus/prose/wikipedia/, so this published file is a modified derivative of CC-BY-SA-4.0 text and inherits its viral share-alike. It carried CC-BY-4.0 while the prose corpus was this repository's own docs; adding Wikipedia is what changed it. See corpus/prose/wikipedia/LICENSE-NOTICE.
